label: TP
reason: Alert 1 is TP because the insecure randomness is used for generating a session ID (rememberMeKey) which is stored in a cookie and used for authentication purposes. Alert 2 is TP because the user-provided value from the cookie (param) flows into the HTML response without proper encoding, creating an XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness used to generate rememberMeKey which is used for session management
User-provided value from cookie flows directly into HTML response without encoding
